name: 2030 interim target
description: Interim milestone on the glide path to net zero: cut embodied purchasing emissions 20% vs the FY2024 baseline. Reachable with today's levers, but only if the wet-lab categories contribute.

name: 2040 interim target
description: Deeper milestone that near-term levers cannot reach: purchasing discipline alone caps out near 24%. Reaching 45% requires the structural 2040-horizon levers - supplier decarbonisation, helium recapture, chemistry redesign - so the gap is closed by a different kind of action, not by trimming harder. That is the finding, not a bug.

name: Net zero 2048
description: UW-Madison bicentennial net-zero commitment; residual emissions offset.
